workflow.content_utf8:
name: Property capabilities and shared delivery source validation

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      revision:
        description: 'Immutable combined coercion, inheritance and shared boxed delivery source commit'
        default: 'c686b70c60d87e0f0726de7dc60dc6fc1f123c48'
        required: true
        type: string
  push:
    branches: ['perf/compact-xaml-theme-codegen']
    paths: ['.github/workflows/winui-property-capabilities-source-validation.yml']

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: winui-property-capabilities-source-${{ github.ref }}-${{ inputs.revision || 'c686b70c60d87e0f0726de7dc60dc6fc1f123c48' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  source-validation:
    name: Actual property capabilities, boxed delivery and fresh WinUI
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          path: tooling
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.revision || 'c686b70c60d87e0f0726de7dc60dc6fc1f123c48' }}
          path: source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Native development dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential binutils curl xz-utils pkg-config time libfontconfig1-dev libfreetype6-dev
      # 415 passing executions, 411 distinct names, exactly four known overlaps;
      # the frozen c686 source and all 27 mandatory regression names are unchanged.
      - name: Compile immutable source and run property capability gates
        env:
          SOURCE_REVISION: ${{ inputs.revision || 'c686b70c60d87e0f0726de7dc60dc6fc1f123c48' }}
        run: |
          python3 tooling/scripts/themes/bench/run_winui_source_validation.py \
            --source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/source" \
            --revision "$SOURCE_REVISION" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/winui-property-capabilities-source-validation" \
            --suite property-capabilities \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::coercion_tests::recoercion_matches_original_owned_value_frames_and_unwind \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::coercion_tests::recoercion_matches_original_reentrant_reads_writes_and_priority_snapshots \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::coercion_tests::metadata_coercion_keeps_clone_only_api_and_callback_pair_lifetimes \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::coercion_tests::metadata_replacement_matches_original_callback_drop_unwind \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::coercion_tests::recoercion_keeps_nan_equality \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::inheritance_tests::inherited_notification_matches_original_values_defaults_and_unwind \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::inheritance_tests::inherited_notification_matches_original_clone_equality_and_handler_reentry \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::inheritance_tests::inherited_notifications_keep_source_metadata_across_overrides_and_attached_hosts \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::inheritance_tests::explicit_inheritance_registration_and_opt_out_keep_public_behavior \
            --required-test ferro_property::styled_property_options_tests::registration_transfers_the_original_coercer \
            --required-test ferro_property_metadata::metadata_table_tests::colliding_cache_entries_follow_replaced_and_removed_registrations \
            --required-test ferro_property_metadata::metadata_table_tests::unregister_invalidates_inherited_and_relocated_overrides \
            --required-test tests::ferro_property_registry_tests::registered_properties_count_reflects_newly_added_attached_property \
            --required-test ferro_property_metadata::coercion_request_tests::borrowed_coercion_requests_keep_the_single_pointer_layout_and_unbounded_types \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::coercion_tests::end_reevaluation_tests::end_reevaluation_matches_original_owned_values_reentry_and_unwind \
            --required-test property_store::effective_value::coercion_tests::end_reevaluation_tests::end_reevaluation_keeps_nan_and_the_retained_uncommon_callback \
            --required-test property_store::value_store::default_coercion_tests::default_coercion_matches_original_metadata_values_factory_and_unwind \
            --required-test property_store::value_store::default_coercion_tests::default_coercion_keeps_metadata_reload_and_returned_entry_cleanup_during_reentry \
            --required-test property_store::value_store::default_coercion_tests::default_coercion_retains_partial_eq_nan_and_absent_callback_behavior \
            --required-test tests::ferro_object_tests_binding::boxed_frame_disposes_the_subscription_returned_after_synchronous_completion_or_error \
            --required-test tests::ferro_object_tests_binding::boxed_frame_subscribes_when_unmasked_and_restores_default_after_disposal \
            --required-test tests::ferro_object_tests_binding::boxed_bindings_snapshot_values_instead_of_retaining_the_incoming_box \
            --required-test tests::ferro_object_tests_binding::retained_boxed_source_observer_does_not_keep_a_disposed_bindings_values_alive \
            --required-test tests::ferro_object_tests_binding::boxed_frame_keeps_its_first_fallback_across_unsubscribe_and_resubscribe \
            --required-test tests::ferro_object_tests_binding::boxed_notification_keeps_snapshots_and_drops_them_after_payload_clone \
            --required-test tests::ferro_object_tests_binding::boxed_binding_conversion_releases_its_temporary_before_delivery_or_clone_unwind \
            --required-test tests::ferro_object_tests_binding::boxed_input_drop_runs_after_the_delivery_releases_its_binding
      - name: Preserve commands, source, results and failure evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: winui-property-capabilities-source-validation-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/winui-property-capabilities-source-validation/evidence
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 1
          retention-days: 14

remaining_gates: Fresh matching production profile and complete graph are still required for this combined runtime source.
The retained boxed-style throughput blocker requires actual paired production measurement of the corrected source.
Existing shipping size and runtime cohorts remain separate immutable historical evidence.
resource_scope: Descriptive command maxima retained from /usr/bin/time; no controlled build performance or memory improvement claim.
scope: Actual frozen combined property capability and restored boxed delivery development-source validation. The original failed runner attempt remains retained. No production size, throughput, allocation, or universal equivalence claim.

This downloads official binary components; it does not compile the repository,
run rustup, change the user's shell, or modify a system installation. Keep the
work directory on a filesystem with room for the downloaded and installed
components, rather than in an automatically cleaned temporary directory.
